result.summary: Independently re-derived PASS by reading test/specs/REQ-062.md and all 4 touched test files directly (not TEST-DESIGNER's summary). All 8 REQ-062 ACs (from step-03-test-designer.json task.acceptance_criteria) have runnable test coverage: AC1/AC2 in sub_process_test.exs (pure filter branches) + engine_sub_process_test.exs (DB-persisted child variables); AC3 (4 failure modes) across sub_process_test.exs error-shape cases + 4 dedicated DB describe blocks in engine_sub_process_test.exs, each asserting zero child rows (activation failures, checked via instance_projection_count/child_projections) or unmodified parent variables (completion failures); AC4 in both files including the SUB_PROCESS_COMPLETED event payload check; AC5 via sub_process_test.exs's GH-428 pure regression test (unrelated PARALLEL_GATEWAY split leaves a sibling waiting token byte-for-byte unchanged) plus engine_sub_process_test.exs's DB set/clear test; AC6 via moduledoc-inspection test plus a functional test forging parent_instance_id into create/2 attrs and confirming it's ignored; AC7 via a real cancel_instance/3 call against a real running child, asserting the child's projection/task/token rows are untouched; AC8 via to_error_args/6's shared error_type pure test plus the same AC3 DB tests additionally asserting error_detail.error_type and exactly one EXECUTION_ERROR event. transition_test.exs's stale catch-all fix was verified directly: :SUB_PROCESS was removed from the {:SERVICE_TASK,:TIMER,:NOT_A_REAL_TYPE} catch-all test list (line 528-531) and a new describe block (line 552) asserts it now dispatches to {:sub_process_start,...} instead of node_type_not_yet_implemented -- this is a real, correct fix, not a cosmetic rename. reconstruction_test.exs's new SUB_PROCESS_COMPLETED replay test (line 674) drives a real parent+child completion through Engine, then reconstructs and asserts the replayed state matches the live projection including waiting_child_instance_id being genuinely cleared by replay. No @tag :skip and no 'TODO: implement test' anywhere in the spec or the 4 test files (grep confirmed zero hits). No hardcoded secrets/connection strings (grep for password/secret_key/api_key/postgres:// /ecto:// found zero hits). Fixtures use per-test-unique data throughout: unique_slug/unique_name/unique_idempotency_key wrap System.unique_integer, and Ecto.UUID.generate() for actor_id -- no shared hardcoded tenant/instance IDs across tests. Tests are self-sufficient: every DB test calls its own provisioned_tenant() which creates a fresh tenant+schema and registers an on_exit that drops the schema and deletes the tenant/registration rows, so no test depends on another having run first or leaves cross-test state. Independently re-verified the describe/test combined-name-length claim via my own Python script (not trusted from the handoff) scanning all describe+test/property string pairs in all 4 files: the true max is 232 chars at test/letflow/engine/transition_test.exs:294 (a pre-existing pair, unrelated to this run's changes), and the largest pair newly added by this run is 219 chars at test/letflow/engine/sub_process_test.exs:317 (AC5 GH-428 test) -- both exactly matching TEST-DESIGNER's claimed figures, well under ExUnit's 255-char ceiling. Ran `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` myself: 'Compiling 81 files (.ex) / Generated letflow app', zero warnings, confirming all 4 test files are at minimum syntactically valid and load cleanly.
